dossier.headline: Big index gains, but most stocks are not joining in
dossier.summary: Several of the market's strongest days have been narrow: on 15–16 Oct and again on 25 Nov, large caps lifted the benchmarks while smallcaps fell and decliners outnumbered advancers on the NSE. The exception was 5 Nov, when advancers beat decliners more than 2 to 1 and every broad index rose.
why_it_matters: A rally carried by a few heavyweights is easier to reverse than a broad one
Smallcap and midcap holders can lose money on days the headline indices rise sharply
